title: Style sample: storybook
objective: Show what a storybook film looks like: layered cut paper whose acts change through palette and light.
audience: The Motion Lab team, reviewing what each style template looks like before using it.

message.core_message: On 7 September 1838 Grace Darling and her father rowed out from Longstone Lighthouse and saved nine people.
key_points: Introduces the person who acts next.
Returns to the start with the outcome.

constraints: Silent: no narration, music or effects; the picture carries it.
Built to style template storybook v2; scene roles follow its scene grammar.

research.reason: Style sample for look review, not a release. On-screen facts are a few well-established figures checked by hand; the source is named on screen. The Forfarshire wreck and the Darlings' rescue of nine survivors (7 September 1838) are well documented.

creative_directions.name: storybook template
creative_directions.concept: A 22-second walk through the storybook template's scene grammar on a subject that fits its visual job: The keeper's daughter.

composition.approach: Portrait only: copy in the top band, the hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

creative_directions.pacing: A planned visual event at least every 2 seconds.
creative_directions.why_it_fits: It is the template's own grammar, so the sample shows the template rather than one film's choices.

success_criteria: Each scene role of the template is recognisable
No frame holds still for more than 2.5 s
